findings.old_behavior:
line_log_print() printed a blank-line separator unconditionally before each diff block using fprintf(rev->diffopt.file, "%s
", prefix). The commit header was followed by a blank line before the diff started.
findings.new_behavior: line_log_queue_pairs() only queues pre-computed filepairs; show_log() and separator emission is deferred to log_tree_diff_flush(). log_tree_diff_flush() only emits the blank-line separator for verbose headers. Non-verbose (--oneline) output no longer has an extra blank line before the diff.
findings.compatibility_reason: Scripts or tools that parse git log -L output and depend on a blank line between the commit header and the diff will see one fewer blank line. Test expectations confirm this: expect files removed blank lines that were previously unconditional. The test  explicitly validates this new behavior.

findings.recommended_review: Review any scripts that parse git log -L output for blank-line dependencies. The commit message explicitly notes this change.
findings.test_recommendation: Run git log -L with various formats (--oneline, --format=, default) and verify blank-line behavior matches the new expectations. Use existing t4211-line-log.sh tests as regression.

findings.old_behavior: When using git log -L with -S/-G/--find-object/--diff-filter, show_log() was called inside line_log_print() before diffcore_std() ran. This meant pickaxe could not suppress commit headers even when no diff pairs survived filtering. All commits in the range were shown.
findings.new_behavior: show_log() is now deferred until after diffcore_std() inside log_tree_diff_flush(). Pickaxe (-S, -G, --find-object) and --diff-filter now properly suppress commits when all pairs are filtered out. Commits without matching content changes are omitted from output.
findings.compatibility_reason: Scripts using git log -L with pickaxe options that previously saw all commits in the range will now see fewer commits (only those matching the pickaxe pattern). This changes the output contract for a documented option combination.
